title: What to say before sleeping
translation: (In Your name O Allah, I live and die.)
whenToRecite: When you lie down to sleep

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
source.hadithReferenceStatus: to be added by reviewer from Sunnah.com

title: Supplications for when you wake up
arabic: (.الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )
translation: (All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.)
transliteration: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.)

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
source.chapterTitle: supplications for when you wake up

title: Invocations before eating
arabic: ((إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ)).
translation: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):In the name of Allah in it’s beginning and end.)
transliteration: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.)

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
source.hadithReferenceStatus: to be added by reviewer from Sunnah.com

title: Invocations after eating
arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ)).
translation: (All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.)
transliteration: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
source.hadithReferenceStatus: to be added by reviewer from Sunnah.com

title: Invocation for entering the restroom
arabic: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).
translation: ((In the name of Allah).  O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.)
transliteration: ((Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.)
whenToRecite: Before you go into the bathroom

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

title: Invocation for leaving the restroom
whenToRecite: When you come out of the bathroom

title: What to say when leaving the home
arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).
translation: (In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.)
transliteration: (Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu AAalal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)
whenToRecite: When you go out of the house

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
source.chapterTitle: What to say when leaving the home
source.hadithReferenceStatus: to be added by reviewer from Sunnah.com

title: What to say when entering the home
arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ).
translation: (In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.)
transliteration: (Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna.)

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
source.chapterTitle: What to say when entering the home

title: Invocation when getting dressed
arabic: (الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة...)
translation: (All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.)
transliteration: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee kasanee hatha (aththawb) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)
whenToRecite: When you put on your clothes

source.work: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
source.hadithReferenceStatus: to be added by reviewer from Sunnah.com

title: Our Lord, give us good
arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةًۭ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
translation: And among them is he who says, “Our Lord, give us goodness in this world, and goodness in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.”
transliteration: Wa minhum mai yaqoolu rabbanaaa aatina fid dunyaa hasanatawn wa fil aakhirati hasanatanw wa qinaa azaaban Naar

source.translationSource: Talal Itani, ClearQuran.com (Allah Edition), CC BY-ND 4.0

title: Asking Allah to forgive us
arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
translation: They said, “Our Lord, we have done wrong to ourselves. Unless You forgive us, and have mercy on us, we will be among the losers.”
transliteration: Qaalaa Rabbanaa zalamnaaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
whenToRecite: When we have made a mistake

source.translationSource: Talal Itani, ClearQuran.com (Allah Edition), CC BY-ND 4.0

title: For me and my parents
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
translation: “Our Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and the believers, on the Day the Reckoning takes place.”
transliteration: Rabbanagh fir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa lilmu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul hisaab

source.translationSource: Talal Itani, ClearQuran.com (Allah Edition), CC BY-ND 4.0

title: Mercy for my parents
arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًۭا
translation: And lower to them the wing of humility, out of mercy, and say, “My Lord, have mercy on them, as they raised me when I was a child.”
transliteration: Wakhfid lahumaa janaahaz zulli minar rahmati wa qur Rabbir hamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheera
whenToRecite: Any time, for Mommy and Daddy

source.translationSource: Talal Itani, ClearQuran.com (Allah Edition), CC BY-ND 4.0

title: Asking for more knowledge
arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا
translation: Exalted is Allah, the True King. Do not be hasty with the Quran before its inspiration to you is concluded, and say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
transliteration: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; wa laa ta'jal bil Quraani min qabli ai yuqdaaa ilaika wahyuhoo wa qur Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa

source.translationSource: Talal Itani, ClearQuran.com (Allah Edition), CC BY-ND 4.0
